same_window_official_stadium_summary: BOAT RACE official 24 venue stadium 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31, previously captured research table
limits: This is post-race weather from third-party transcribed CSV, not a prediction input.
Reference official venue aggregates and result sample have different eligibility denominators; do not demand exact equality.
Association and unadjusted wind differences are not evidence of wind causation.
Limited 92-day seasonal sample; rainy/windy race selection and athlete quality differ.
Directions are numeric source codes and must not be labeled as head/tail without verified map.
Strong-wind venue comparisons with fewer than 100 rows in either group are null; holdout not evaluated.
Not authorized to change model probabilities or publish a predeadline forecast.

wind_direction_reconciliation.note: Direction code values are raw 1-8 or blank; no head/tail mapping, no model use.
